title: Locusts get a sensory assist from nanomaterials
summary_en: Researchers from WashU McKelvey Engineering have developed a hybrid system that augments organisms including locusts to serve as sample collectors for chemical vapors. The work has implications for homeland security, environmental and industrial monitoring and healthcare.
title_cn: Locusts get a sensory assist from nanomaterials

title: Sterling Lawrence: ‘It Is What It Is When It Is’
summary_en: The Sam Fox School Gallery at Washington University in St. Louis presents “It Is What It Is When It Is,” a solo exhibition of new work from St. Louis-based artist Sterling Lawrence.
title_cn: Sterling Lawrence: ‘It Is What It Is When It Is’
